colorectal.label: Pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks
additional_support: No routine antiemetic prophylaxis or routine infusion premedication is usually required. Use an individual/local symptom-relief prescription if needed.
Carry the immunotherapy alert card and report possible immune symptoms promptly during and after treatment.
Effective contraception during treatment and at least 4 months after the last dose.
For this colorectal context, eligibility is first-line MSI-H/dMMR metastatic disease; PD-L1 is not the colorectal selection test. Do not import a lung adjuvant course cap.
FBC, renal/liver profile and glucose before each cycle. Thyroid tests every 3–6 weeks: keep thyroid checks when due regardless of the infusion interval. Cortisol as clinically indicated.
Review any immune toxicity and steroid dose before restarting; no routine dose reduction. Delayed immune effects may occur after treatment stops.
